name: Patient Trackbed
description: Run qi along both dry arms from root to tip to find any crack before the string is wound.

name: Rallying Sinewcord
description: Walk the string back to the catch in measured pulls, each pull timed with an out-breath.

name: Stakescorer
description: Brace the front foot against the carriage rail and throw a bolt flat to middle range.

name: Layered Stockbed
description: Swing the unwound arm of the engine across the front to knock a thrown spear aside.

name: Harsh Bolthead
description: Pack qi into both arms as the string is drawn, so the release throws the bolt well past ordinary range.

name: Impalement Slap
description: Loose the bolt as an armoured charger's shield lifts, driving the head through the gap beneath it.

name: Sure Springarm
description: Rub oil into the skein with a palm of warm qi until the sinew gleams and takes no moisture.

name: Tenderhearted Aimframe
description: Pluck the skein like a string and judge by its pitch whether the tension has gone slack.

name: Genial Bowarms
description: Wind the skeins in staggered half turns, a breath of qi guiding each, so the twist runs even.

name: Sturdy Windlassdrum
description: Open the lever and bleed the skein's strain through the catch the moment a crack is heard.

name: Clawslap
description: Loose a bolt from a skein held at pre-set twist, trading a little force for speed.

name: Rude Boltflight
description: Charge the wound skein with a surge of qi and release one bolt carrying far beyond its plain flight.

name: Streakswat
description: Send a bolt low across the front of an advancing line so the nearest men halt and drop to cover.

name: Sleet Trackbed
description: Kick the wheel lock down with the heel so the carriage stays planted as the string is wound.

name: Clayhurtle
description: Haul the carriage forward with a thread of qi in the legs, never letting it tilt on rough ground.

name: Soothing Windlassdrum
description: Dab fat on each axle end in a quick pass so the wheels turn silently when moved.

name: Attentive Bolthead
description: Drop two planks in the engine's path and roll across them to avoid sinking in soft soil.

name: Stubborn Sinewcord
description: Drive the iron tail spike into the ground with a boot and a pulse of qi, locking the carriage against recoil.

name: Sliderthwack
description: Halt the rolling carriage with a braced hold and loose at once, before the shaking has settled.

name: Clawzip
description: Spin the engine on one locked wheel with a push of qi in the legs, bringing the bolt line about in a breath.

name: Clayslider
description: Fire in rhythm while the platform rolls forward in short steps, keeping defenders' heads down as it nears the line.

name: Knitting Bowarms
description: Slide the wedge under the rear stock a hair at a time until the bolt line meets the chosen elevation.

name: Kindly Stockbed
description: Hang a small plumb on a cord from the stock's midpoint to see the engine's slant at a glance.

name: Cooling Springarm
description: Feel the wind on the cheek and lean the stock's nose a hair into it before releasing.

name: Quickening Aimframe
description: Lift the nose by two marks when the target stands on high ground, and drop it when the target lies below.

name: Skewerbolt Scorer
description: Raise the stock steeply and push qi along the arms so the bolt falls from above onto a mark behind low cover.

name: Stakethwack
description: Add a measured twist of qi to the arm release so the bolt rides stiff and true through a hard wind.

name: Sound Sinewcord
description: Call each crew post by name and wait for the answer, learning at once which man is not ready.

name: Hum Windlassdrum
description: Pass wound, loaded and clear to the aimer by raised hand signs when the noise is too great for the voice.

name: Dawn Trackbed
description: Rotate the crew on the winch bar after every ten turns so no arm tires before the string is home.

name: Stakedrive Zip
description: Step into a fallen crewman's post without a word and take up the next duty in the sequence.

name: Alert Aimframe
description: Raise a fist to freeze the whole crew mid-motion when a bolt line crosses a friendly body.

name: Hearty Bowarms
description: Keep a running tally of bolts left in the rack and warn the crew when the store runs low.

name: Emberhurtle
description: Run the crew through a drilled cycle of wind, load and loose, so a bolt flies at a steady interval.

name: Duskstreak
description: Quicken the cycle at a shout, driving the crew to loose the next three bolts as fast as hands allow.

name: Staticstreak
description: Bark the rally call with qi in the lungs, steadying frightened loaders and unsettling enemies within earshot.

name: Soothing Bolthead
description: Weigh each shaft in the palm and sort heavy from light by feel before the day's shooting.

name: Rallying Springarm
description: Twist each iron head on its socket and test that it sits square and will not loosen in flight.

name: Stakeslap
description: Seat a light shaft and loose it at once to catch a runner before he reaches cover.

name: Knitting Stockbed
description: Wind the arms a full extra turn for a heavy shaft, matching the string's strength to its weight.

name: Sound Bolthead
description: Tie coloured thread rings behind each head to tell the weights apart in the dark.

name: Keen Skewerbolt
description: Drive a heavy iron-headed bolt, qi in the arms, through a wooden door or plank barrier in one blow.

name: Clawbuckle
description: Loose a barbed bolt through the loose cloth of a man's cloak or a tent flap, pinning it fast.

name: Shielding Sinewcord
description: Slide the wooden mantlet across the front of the stock so the aimer is covered at the moment of release.

name: Genial Trackbed
description: Sight through the narrow slit of the mantlet with qi steadying the eye against flying splinters.

name: Sleet Claw
description: Throw a wet hide over the engine to turn aside a fire arrow and keep the wood from catching.

name: Cooling Aimframe
description: Reload bent double beneath the mantlet's lip, the bolt passed forward without the head rising.

name: Rill Springarm
description: Angle the mantlet face and push with qi to glance away a heavy bolt from an opposing engine.

name: Hurtlescorer
description: Open the mantlet, loose the bolt, and slam it shut within one breath, leaving no gap for return fire.

name: Gap Windlassdrum
description: Pace out the ground to a known post and keep the count as a standing measure of range.

name: Recall Stockbed
description: Compare a standing man's shadow with the engine's own to guess his distance by a known ratio.

name: Attentive Bowarms
description: Hold the notched range rod at arm's length against the target and read its width against the notches.

name: Emberslider
description: Loose a first bolt only to see where it lands, then correct the aim for the second.

name: Purpose Bowarms
description: Scratch the bolt's landing mark on the stock beside the elevation setting so the correction is remembered.

name: Brawn Bolthead
description: Take three slow breaths with qi settling in the dantian before the second shot to still the hands.

name: Hurtleflog
description: Place one bolt short and the next long of the mark by measure, closing the gap with the third.

name: Sliderscorer
description: Pick out the one rider bearing a bright banner from far off and send a single bolt down the measured line.
